name: platform-foundations
description: Shared Platform foundation for PlainConcepts Platform apps: theme, conventions, docs, and a themed component showcase.

scripts.verify: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm build
scripts.release:theme: pnpm --filter @plainconceptsplatform/ui-components build && pnpm typecheck && pnpm --filter @plainconceptsplatform/ui-theme publish --access public
scripts.release:components: pnpm --filter @plainconceptsplatform/ui-components build && pnpm typecheck && pnpm --filter @plainconceptsplatform/ui-components publish --access public
